title: Consume Safeguard against exactly one future Jam or Disconnect
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. At R3 allow the current Shift Lead to protect one active player. Track the unused protection until it prevents the next Jam or Disconnect against that target, then expire it; do not expire merely because a round changes. Enforce actor/phase/revision and prevent duplicate use/retarget outside the one granted power. Apply protection before the blocked effect or Null-Disconnect victory and expose only its permitted public marker, not a role inference.
acceptance: A valid R3 action protects the chosen active target and persists until a matching blocking event.
One Jam or Disconnect is prevented and consumes protection exactly once; an unrelated target/effect does not consume it.
Unauthorized/stale/repeated protection cannot grant extra charges or expose target alignment.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
